title: PREREG_MEVA — Đề tài 09, CP1 pre-registration (MEVA S8, definition (b'), STRATA_SPEC v2)

design.target: MEVA S8 (plan 1101322c...; 10 blocks, 5 cameras x 3 sessions, 1,062,229 frames), detector route cuda_fp32_kaggle (gate tier event)
design.event_definition: (b') on BOTH sides: person conf >= 0.7, idle gaps <= round(0.2 s x fps) merged inside a segment (MEVA 30 fps: k = 6)
design.strata: STRATA_SPEC v2 (pooled R -> D -> C), cells from results/strata_map_benchmark.csv (bprime, v2, main)
design.false_open_per_hour: false-open / frame x 30 fps x 3600 (MEVA header fps)
design.units: camera (5) and session (3) of S8; 'all' = summary; the pooling-dependent block is its own unit
design.transportable_part: frames in cells != U (rule v2) of non-pooling-dependent blocks
design.naive: pooled ratio over all windows of the 121 main benchmark videos (incl. benchmark U windows)
design.transport: sum_h w_T(h) nu_B(h) / sum_h w_T(h) delta_B(h) over supported cells (Theorem 1(a))
design.PI: for the OBSERVED value M_obs: transport +- t(0.975, df=2) = 4.3027 x sqrt(v_boot + v_obs); v_boot = variance of the benchmark-video cluster bootstrap with w_T fixed at the observed profile; v_obs = sum_h nwin_T(h) Var_B(N - M Q | h) / Dhat^2 (Dhat transported) -- the form validated in synthetic_check.py (COND), with 1.96 replaced by t_2 (Q-D/D3.6). B = 1000, seed 42
design.CI_secondary: percentile CI with the unit's blocks resampled jointly with benchmark videos (block bootstrap, D3.6); also CI_twoway for M_T(w_T) (camera x session two-way for 'all'; for camera / session units the one available dimension = the unit's blocks) and CI_cond (benchmark only)
design.bounds: Theorem 1(b) closed forms on ALL frames of the unit (incl. U and the pooling-dependent block): supported cells by plug-in, U windows by per-window logical boxes (processed >= floor(n/16)/n for P2-P4, exact phase-averaged count for P1; false-open <= ceil(n/2)/n, <= processed for P1; recall numerator in [0, e]; precision closed form). Also the PREREG_DECISIONS P-2 form [(1-w) M, (1-w) M + w] (width = omega).
design.observed: M_obs = sum N / sum Q over the unit's transportable windows (computed only after unlock)
design.E4_check: the observed value on ALL frames of a unit must lie inside the ORACLE Theorem 1(b) bounds (observed supported part + U boxes) -- a violation is a bug; containment of the observed value in the pre-registered plug-in bounds is a reported result (it can fail through A1 only)
design.H3_cell_rule: cell PASS iff |transport - M_obs| <= 0.5 |naive - M_obs|; cell undefined if the observed denominator is 0

H1.status: confirmatory-of-profile (observed before pre-registration; not a blind prediction)
H1.criterion: TV(w_B, w_T) >= 0.3 in >= 2 of 3 definitions {(a), (b'), (c)}; (c) census only, mapped on the (b') benchmark cells. Refuted (PLAN §3) if the MEVA duty cycle lies inside the benchmark 95 % CI (cluster bootstrap over the 121 videos, frame-weighted) for >= 2 of 3 definitions. H1 = PASS iff the TV criterion holds AND the refutation clause does not fire.
H1.note: Both components are profile facts already seen. The TV part holds (3/3) while the duty-cycle refutation clause fires for (a) and (b'): benchmark and MEVA differ in temporal COMPOSITION (strata: idle-run lengths, censoring) far more than in duty cycle. Flag for Dat: the PLAN wording makes H1 FAIL on duty cycle although TV >= 0.3 in every definition.
H1.p_value_rule: p_H1 = second-smallest of the three one-sided two-way bootstrap p-values P(TV* <= 0.3) (>= 2 of 3 must hold).

H2.criterion: At the 'all' unit (transportable part of S8): for policy x metric with metric in {processed fraction, event recall, false-open/frame}, deterministic-by-construction cells (P1 x processed) excluded: (A) |naive - M_obs| > PI half-width and (B) composition share = (transport - naive) / (M_obs - naive) >= 0.5 (Kitagawa-Oaxaca, ratio form, benchmark reference). H2 PASS if, for >= 1 of the 3 metrics, (A) and (B) hold for a majority of its eligible policy cells (processed: P2-P4, need 2 of 3; event recall and false-open: 7 cells, need 4 of 7).
H2.p_value_rule: per policy x metric: two-sided t test of bias / (PI_half / t_crit), df = 2; per metric p_m = k-th smallest p (k = required majority); p_H2 = min(1, 3 x min_m p_m) (Bonferroni over the 3 metrics)
H2.predicted_direction: not predicted numerically beyond the per-cell naive / transport / PI below

H3.criterion: Binding (D3.3): |transport - M_obs| <= 0.5 |naive - M_obs| in >= 80 % of the H3 denominator cells. Coverage of the PI is reported only.
H3.denominator_rule: camera and session units x 7 policies x 5 metrics, transportable part only; EXCLUDED and listed: cells whose transport is undefined from the profile (no transported denominator mass, e.g. recall where every supported window is idle); also EXCLUDED and reported separately: (i) the pooling-dependent block (D3.2) [its frames are removed from camera P-4 and session 03-07]; (ii) expected-FAIL cells P2/P3 x frame recall (D3.5); (iii) deterministic-by-construction cells P1(K) x {processed fraction, frame recall} (phase-averaged P1 processes each frame with probability exactly 1/K; naive, transport and observed all equal 1/K up to segment-start frames, so the error ratio is a clip-boundary artefact ~1e-4) -- added by Claude at CP1, flagged for Dat's review; H3 is also reported with (iii) included as a sensitivity row; (iv) any cell whose observed denominator is 0 (undefined), listed.
H3.p_value_rule: exact one-sided binomial P(X >= k | n, 0.5) on the denominator cells (descriptive: cells are not independent)

H4.criterion: AUC(score -> observed flip) >= 0.75 over pair x metric x unit (camera and session units); score = TV(w_B, w_T) / r*, with w_B, w_T renormalised over the supported cells (the ball of flip_radius.py) and w_T from the unit's transportable part; r* = inf -> score 0. Flip observed = sign of Delta on the unit's transportable part differs from sign_B (tie = flip).
H4.r_star: LP flip_radius.py on the benchmark supported cells (NOT the closed form)
H4.exclusion: P1 vs P1 pairs for processed, frame recall, event recall, false-open (K-monotone ordering in every window: cannot flip; would only add guaranteed true negatives); kept for precision
H4.ci_rule: bootstrap over pair x metric clusters, B = 1000, seed 42; p = P(AUC* <= 0.5)
H4.min_class_rule: if < 5 flips or < 5 non-flips, H4 = INCONCLUSIVE (reported as not PASS)

multiplicity: Holm over p_H1..p_H4 at alpha = 0.05. Binding verdicts are the criteria above on point values; Holm-adjusted p is reported alongside (a criterion met without Holm significance is labelled 'PASS (not significant after Holm)').

E6.note: sensitivity only; does not change H1-H4. Each axis repeats E3 (transport, PI, error ratio) with operating points and P4 coefficients frozen.

axes.b_raw: (b) raw instead of (b') on both sides (benchmark cells (b), v2)
axes.rule_v1: STRATA_SPEC v1 partition merge instead of v2 pooled
axes.D_fine: D classes <=2 / 3-5 / 6-10 / 11-30 / 31-100 / >100 frames (support rule unchanged, v2)
axes.cue_baseline: 4th stratum component: tercile (benchmark cut points) of log10 of the causal cue median m_t at the window's first frame
axes.norm_300: cue normalisation median over 300 instead of 1800 previous frames (both sides)
axes.fps_15: benchmark videos of unknown fps assumed 15 fps (k_merge 3) instead of 25
axes.fps_30: benchmark videos of unknown fps assumed 30 fps (k_merge 6) instead of 25
axes.route_laptop: 6 P-1 clips with the laptop ov_gpu_fp32x detections instead of Kaggle (g(b') already shown identical on 54,005 frames -> expected identical)
